## Notes

PIANO architecture with concurrent modules and a cognitive controller; 10 to 1000+ agents in Minecraft (results up to 500); role specialization; 29-agent constitution and 20 percent tax experiment with influencers and votes; Pastafarianism seeded by 20 priests; GPT-4o base model.
